fields.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
fields.note: The document supports a per-tenant amount, a per-unit maximum, an additional amount for elderly (62+) or disabled tenants, and dependence on the notice service date. It does not say that amounts adjust each March 1, although the rate periods run March 1 to February 28.
The current and prior-period amounts ($10,863.45 / $32,590.33 / $7,278.67) match the table in the document.
The document shows the current rate period beginning 3/1/2026 for notices served in that window. It does not state an enactment date or the 2006 start of the rule.
The current rate table lists the payments for notices served in the current period, which implies the rule is in force.

fields.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
fields.note: The document supports coverage of tenants evicted under the Ellis Act. It says nothing about the withdrawal of all units in a building, the June 13, 1979 Certificate of Occupancy exemption, or the rule applying to rental units under the Rent Ordinance's eviction provisions.
The section number 37.9A appears only in a link label placed next to the Ellis Act table. The document does not give the 'S.F. Admin. Code' form of the citation.
